name: No AI Slop
description: Bundles the `no-ai-slop` editing skill and runs it on every finished answer: a separate reviewer with a fresh context reads the reply, names the AI-slop patterns it finds, and the agent rewrites the answer to fix them. One pass by default, configurable up to twelve, or set to 0 and trigger it by hand from the composer '+' menu. A clean answer is left alone silently.
tagline: Every answer edited until it stops sounding like AI

composer_controls.label: No AI slop
composer_controls.description: Check this turn's answer for AI-slop patterns, even when automatic passes are set to 0.

fields.label: Automatic review passes
fields.description: How many times a finished answer is reviewed and rewritten. Each pass is a fresh reviewer with no memory of the last one. 0 turns automatic review off, leaving the composer '+' toggle as a manual trigger.

fields.label: What a review does
fields.description: Rewrite has the agent revise its own answer. Report leaves the answer alone and shows the findings beside it.
